title: PeerRateLimiter behind std Mutex — async tasks hold lock across await points implicitly
description: session.rs: shared.peer_rate_limiter is Arc<std::sync::Mutex<PeerRateLimiter>>. Each TAKETHIS and IHAVE handler calls .lock().unwrap().check() — that specific call is non-async and releases the lock immediately, so no await-while-locked bug exists today. However PeeringShared is pub and any future maintainer adding an await between lock acquisition and release will cause a deadlock or panic. A tokio::sync::Mutex or a redesign to hold the lock for exactly one check per article should be documented with a DECISION comment.
